title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, or, a Dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature : enlarged and improved. Illustrated with nearly six hundred engravings - Fifth edition, Volume 6, CHI-Crystallization - EB.10
text: One of the best regulations of the company is, not to leave the confuls, or even ambafidor, to fix the im-position on veffel for defraying the common expenses ( a thing deal to the companies) if not other nation ;) but to allow a portion to the ambaffador and confuls, and even to the chief officers, as secretary, chapish, interpreters, and jailaries, that there may not be any preference for their rating any fam at all on the merchants or merchandise.
